summary: Practise PPP performance monitoring, payment assessment and change control. Review the five-day course outline and choose your next step.
lede: PPP contract management is the post-award administration of an agreement, including monitoring service obligations and applying its terms consistently. For public-sector contract managers, project officers and private-partner liaison teams, this training develops practical ways to verify KPI evidence, assess payment adjustments, control changes and escalate issues using documented records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who monitor live PPP agreements, assess service evidence or coordinate decisions when performance, payment and contract records do not align. It suits people with working exposure to contract administration or PPP project operations.
modules: PPP Governance Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working knowledge of contract administration or public-private partnership project operations is recommended. You should be able to read contract schedules and discuss service performance, payment or change issues from your work context.
